name: Return to Ash
source:
What would you do if you woke up in the afterlife?

The hospital room she knew is gone. Beyond the window lies a blank, white void that stretches endlessly. Instead of the usual aches and pains, she awakens feeling better than she has in years. Is this a dream, or…?

Return to Ash is a narrative-driven visual novel focused on emotional storytelling and relationship building. Your decisions will shape Ashleigh’s journey, and determine how her story ends.

Explore a mysterious afterlife, forge bonds with others trapped in this strange purgatory, and face impossible, torturous trials from a masked being who calls themself “Death”.

[From [url=https://serenityforge.com/games/return-to-ash]official website[/url]]
translation:
如果一覺醒來，發現自己到了死後的世界，你會怎麼辦？

熟悉的病房已經消失。窗外是一片空白，白茫茫的虛無一直延伸，沒有盡頭。平日的痠痛不見了，她醒來時竟覺得身體多年來從未這樣輕快。是在做夢嗎，還是……？

《歸入塵埃》是一部注重情感敘事與人際羈絆的劇情向視覺小說。你的決定將左右艾希莉的旅程，也將決定她的故事如何結束。

探索神秘的死後世界，與同樣被困在這片奇異煉獄中的人們建立羈絆，面對一個戴著面具、自稱「死神」的存在所設下的試煉——每一場都難如登天、折磨人心。

［取自[url=https://serenityforge.com/games/return-to-ash]官方網站[/url]］
